scope: Independent source review and direct GLB geometry fitting inspection; not browser visual approval or release approval.

method.runtime: Bun 1.4.2 with Three.js r170 GLTFLoader and MeshoptDecoder
method.inputs: Actual shipped heroModelPaths(hero).base and public/models/dungeon-forge-v2/forge-{form}-v2.glb for five heroes, eight forms, eleven nodes. Image references were stripped from in-memory GLB JSON only to load without DOM; nodes, geometry, transforms, skin data and indices remained unchanged.
method.steps: Computed original weapon bounds in each weapon node local frame, fitted actual new geometry, measured nearest vertex distance to socket origin, main-axis extent error, and finite positions/normals. The before pass used the previous AABB-center fit; after pass used the corrected form-aware origin-preserving fit.
method.distanceMeaning: Nearest-vertex distance in weapon node local model units; a diagnostic for grip displacement, not a measured distance from an animated rendered hand surface.

findings.problem: AABB-center translation moved asymmetric axe and bow handles away from socket origin. One-handed axe was authored with blade +X while original blade points -X.
findings.evidence: Barbarian one-handed axe original local bounds x[-0.588885543084,0.125536093971]. Prior fitting displaced authored grip origin by x=-0.417066199072; nearest fitted vertex was 0.371175703902 from socket origin. Bow prior origin x=-0.285469688475.
findings.correction: fitForgedWeapon now receives the explicit form, keeps grip origin at zero without centroid translation, rotates axe by PI around Y (preserving winding), rotates bow onto Z, and fits positive/negative longitudinal extents relative to zero.
findings.verification: Actual 11-node geometry inspection: all positions/normals finite, max main-axis extent error 5.832721328147272e-8. Axe nearest vertex became 0.066084695557; bow 0.050441204866; staff 0.061460997785. Actual rendered hand/attack pose remains a separate check.

otherReviewedBoundaries: Weapon templates are awaited during hero model loading before prepareModel and cached by form.
Replaced weapon geometry/material disposal excludes buffers still referenced by the scene; shared textures remain cached.
Encounter aliases retain kaykit rig selection and base animation clips; added authored surfaces preserve vertex color and bind to existing bones.
Weapon trails retain fixed update buffers; FX removes/disposes expired trails and contact sprite materials.
Contact ring texture and sprite/material feature variants participate in existing FX preparation.
Blender generation and meshopt delivery scripts were reviewed against current asset contracts.
limitations: No source review can establish visual quality, successful live deployment, physical mobile performance, or actual animated grip appearance.
Unit/typecheck PASS1785 was root-reported context, not a fresh independent full-suite run for this review.

New geometry and model instances consume Three UUID Math.random draws; map-specific seeded generation is preserved but global gameplay random sequence identity is not claimed. See work/dungeon-surface-rng/report.json.

QA4 dark rectangular floor patches were inspected in saved screenshots and tentatively match preexisting region-architecture threshold slabs. Runtime raycast attribution was requested but had not been received when this report was saved.
Source hashes are captured when this report is saved and identify the reviewed corrected files; no product files were edited during this review.
